scripts.build: bun run notices && tsc -b && vp build
scripts.build:staging: bun run notices && tsc -b && CLOUDFLARE_ENV=staging vp build --mode staging
scripts.build:production: bun run notices && tsc -b && CLOUDFLARE_ENV=production vp build --mode production
scripts.upload:staging: bun run build:staging && CLOUDFLARE_ENV=staging wrangler versions upload
scripts.deploy:staging: bun run build:staging && CLOUDFLARE_ENV=staging wrangler deploy
scripts.upload:production: bun run build:production && CLOUDFLARE_ENV=production wrangler versions upload
scripts.deploy:production: bun run build:production && CLOUDFLARE_ENV=production wrangler deploy
scripts.check: bun run --cwd ../.. --no-install i18n:check && bun run format-check && bun run cf-typegen:check && bun run type-check && bun run lint && bun run test && bun run build:production
scripts.lint: bun run --cwd ../.. --no-install vp lint frontend/app frontend/shared --deny-warnings
scripts.format: bun run --cwd ../.. --no-install vp fmt frontend/app frontend/shared
scripts.format-check: bun run --cwd ../.. --no-install vp fmt frontend/app frontend/shared --check
scripts.lighthouse: lhci collect && status=0 && { lhci assert || status=$?; lhci upload; exit $status; }
